title: Invest Level Survey

notice.title: A higher level is not necessarily better.
notice.body: Your invest level only determines the terminology difficulty used in analysis reports. A report full of unfamiliar terms will make decision-making harder. Please choose honestly based on what you actually understand.

stageQuestion: Select all terms below that you know the meaning of or have actually used in investment decisions.

adjust.title: You can manually adjust your level
adjust.desc: If a different level suits you better, change it below. The terminology difficulty in analysis reports will adjust accordingly.

levels.초급자: Receive analysis with easy explanations focused on basic terms.
levels.중급자: Receive analysis including interpretation of key technical and flow indicators.
levels.고급자: Receive analysis covering valuation and macro indicators.
levels.전문가: Receive analysis using derivative and advanced macro terms as-is.
